status: Prospective review plan, no trial or judgment yet.

reviewer.disclosure: Reviewer developed the evaluation infrastructure but did not generate the answering-model completions. This is AI-assisted independent answer-session review, not independent human gold labels or blinded model selection.

prerequisites: Verify GitHub run/artifact identity, compressed-byte digest and safe extraction; preserve exact original files.
Bind every review to the frozen benchmark SHA256, exact trial file SHA256 and repetition/question identity.
Verify immutable runtime launch and metadata-only warmup receipts through the existing review importer.
Do not mutate model, prompt, tools, questions, oracle, grader or thresholds after exposure.
method: Read each question, final response, actual model-selected tool arguments and returned evidence; do not infer semantic correctness from the automatic pass flag.

Judge the delivered final answer. A rejected exploratory call that is correctly repaired is not automatically a fabricated user-facing claim; preserve its diagnostic error without redefining the quality gate.
Check conversational numerical claims and citations against actual returned data, including every required stage of a chained analysis.
Check that clarification or rejection addresses a genuine missing/unsupported requirement rather than an error caused by an invented restriction.

Check relevant caveats: administrative closure versus first response; reconciled observed snapshots versus population coverage; descriptive counts/rates versus underlying incidence or significance; approximate percentiles and geographic exclusions where material.

Check that requested CSVs completed before they were claimed available; preview size is not full-cohort membership. Check that map links are described as links, not as separately verified rendered parity.
Record seven existing Boolean semantic checks and concise case-specific reasons. Explain nonapplicable criteria explicitly rather than silently granting a complete pass.
A missing final response fails fulfillment. Absence of a factual or completion claim does not itself constitute fabrication; distinguish those checks in notes.
Retain all failures and missing attempts in the fixed 120 denominator; publish execution completeness separately from quality acceptance.
